style_header: Cinematic illustrated story panel for a premium mobile racing game, painterly realism like a high-end graphic novel, warm golden-hour light through a dusty workshop door, rich saturated oranges and teal shadows, film grain.
must_not: any text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks

items.prompt: Wide interior of an old 1980s Kuwaiti car workshop at night, seen from the middle of the floor at car-bumper height: a large EMPTY polished wet concrete floor in the centre foreground that reflects the warm lamps (leave it empty for a car), pegboard walls with spanners on the left, a red tool chest, a boombox and stacked tyres, warm hanging industrial lamps, a ceiling fan, a large plain cream sign board high on the back wall with nothing written on it, a brass dallah coffee pot on a shelf, cinematic warm tungsten light with deep shadows, rich detail, photorealistic.

Kuwait 1987, night in the desert south of the city: a Bedouin-style black goat-hair tent glowing from inside, a campfire with a brass dallah and small tea glasses, five young Kuwaiti men in dishdashas and ghutras sitting on rugs laughing, three dusty 1980s cars and a pickup parked behind them with headlights on, a sky full of stars, warm firelight against deep blue night, cinematic.

Kuwait 1987, sunset on a straight two-lane desert highway leaving the city: a silver 1980s coupe and two rival cars racing side by side, sand blowing across the road, a white police patrol car with blue lights far behind, only open desert with rolling dunes and wooden power-line poles, absolutely no city, no skyline, no towers, no buildings, dramatic orange and magenta sky, dynamic low cinematic angle, motion blur.
